classes.label: batches
classes.description: Manufacturing batch records for pharmaceutical seed materials, tracking batch lifecycle from creation through quality testing and expiration, supporting traceability and regulatory compliance in pharmaceutical production.

properties.label: batch_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing batch, used for traceability and regulatory tracking

properties.label: expiry_date
properties.description: Date after which the batch material is no longer suitable for use due to stability or regulatory requirements

properties.label: lot
properties.description: Lot number assigned to the batch for inventory and traceability purposes

properties.label: quantity_kg
properties.description: Weight of the batch material in kilograms

properties.label: release_test_status
properties.description: Quality assurance status indicating whether the batch has passed release testing and is approved for use

properties.label: status
properties.description: Current manufacturing or processing status of the batch (e.g., active, quarantined, released, rejected)

classes.label: drugs
classes.description: Master catalog of pharmaceutical drug candidates in development at Calanthir Pharma, containing core attributes including drug identifiers, names, therapeutic classifications, development phases, and batch tracking information for research and development pipeline management.

properties.label: development_phase
properties.description: Current stage of drug development (e.g., discovery, preclinical, Phase I, Phase II, Phase III, Phase IV) indicating progress toward regulatory approval

properties.label: drug_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for each drug candidate in the Calanthir Pharma development pipeline

properties.label: modality
properties.description: Type or class of therapeutic modality (e.g., small molecule, biologic, antibody, gene therapy) that defines the drug's mechanism of action

properties.label: name
properties.description: Commercial or development name of the pharmaceutical drug candidate

properties.label: therapeutic_area
properties.description: Medical or therapeutic domain in which the drug is intended to treat (e.g., oncology, cardiology, immunology)

classes.label: events
classes.description: Event log capturing critical operational and quality incidents occurring during pharmaceutical manufacturing and batch processing at Calanthir facilities. Records manufacturing events, quality deviations, material handling issues, and other significant occurrences tied to specific batches, materials, and production sites.

properties.label: date
properties.description: Date and time when the event occurred or was recorded

properties.label: event_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for each recorded event or incident in the manufacturing process

properties.label: event_type
properties.description: Categorical classification of the event (e.g., deviation, observation, equipment failure, material issue)

properties.label: name
properties.description: Human-readable name or title describing the nature of the event

properties.label: severity
properties.description: Level of impact or urgency assigned to the event (e.g., critical, major, minor)

properties.label: site_id
properties.description: Identifier of the manufacturing facility or production site where the event occurred

classes.label: kpi_drives
classes.description: Maps relationships between KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) showing which KPIs drive or influence other KPIs within the Calanthir pharmaceutical data ecosystem. This table establishes directional dependencies and cause-effect relationships between performance metrics.

properties.label: drives_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for each KPI drive relationship record

classes.label: kpis
classes.description: Master catalog of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) used to measure pharmaceutical operational and clinical performance, including target values, materiality thresholds, and classification hierarchies for strategic monitoring and governance.

properties.label: clinical
properties.description: Flag or category indicating whether the KPI relates to clinical outcomes, safety, or regulatory compliance

properties.label: kpi_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for each Key Performance Indicator

properties.label: materiality_usd
properties.description: Monetary materiality threshold in USD that determines the significance or reporting importance of deviations from KPI targets

properties.label: name
properties.description: Human-readable name or title of the Key Performance Indicator

properties.label: target_value
properties.description: The target or goal value that the KPI should achieve or maintain

properties.label: tier
properties.description: Hierarchical classification level of the KPI indicating its strategic importance (e.g., executive, department, operational)

properties.label: unit
properties.description: Measurement unit for the KPI value (e.g., percentage, count, days, USD, etc.)

classes.label: materials
classes.description: Master catalog of raw materials and pharmaceutical ingredients used in drug manufacturing, including sourcing information, lead times, and quality specifications for supply chain planning and procurement operations.

properties.label: baseline_lead_days
properties.description: Baseline or standard lead time in days established as a reference point for supply chain planning and performance comparison.

properties.label: gmp_grade
properties.description: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) grade or quality level of the material, indicating compliance with pharmaceutical manufacturing standards.

properties.label: is_assay
properties.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires assay testing or certificate of analysis (CoA) verification before use in manufacturing.

properties.label: lead_time_days
properties.description: Current or typical number of calendar days required for procurement and delivery of the material from the supplier.

properties.label: material_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the material in the system, used as the primary key for tracking and referencing raw materials across operations.

properties.label: material_type
properties.description: Classification of the material category such as active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), excipient, solvent, or packaging material.

properties.label: name
properties.description: Commercial or chemical name of the material used for identification and procurement purposes.

classes.label: measured_by
classes.description: Junction table that maps KPI (Key Performance Indicator) measurements to their associated context dimensions including suppliers, materials, batches, trials, and measurement sites. This table enables tracking which KPIs are measured for specific pharmaceutical seed materials from particular suppliers across different production batches and trial sites.

properties.label: measured_by_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for this measurement-to-KPI mapping record

properties.label: site_id
properties.description: Reference to the physical or logical site where the measurement is performed

classes.label: owns
classes.description: Association table that establishes ownership relationships between individuals and key performance indicators (KPIs) in the Calanthir pharmaceutical COA (Certificate of Analysis) induction system, enabling tracking of KPI accountability and responsibility assignment.

properties.label: owns_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the ownership relationship record between a person and a KPI

classes.label: persons
classes.description: Master registry of individuals within the Calanthir pharmaceutical organization, capturing core identity and organizational assignment details for workforce management and access control purposes.

properties.label: name
properties.description: Full name or display name of the person

properties.label: org_unit
properties.description: Organizational unit, department, or business area to which the person is assigned

properties.label: person_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for an individual within the pharmaceutical organization

properties.label: role
properties.description: Job title or functional role assigned to the person within the organization

classes.label: regions
classes.description: Master reference table that defines pharmaceutical regulatory regions and their associated governance frameworks. Each region is linked to its primary regulatory body and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) jurisdiction, enabling compliance tracking and regulatory adherence across Calanthir Pharma's operations.

properties.label: gmp_jurisdiction
properties.description: Designated GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) jurisdiction classification for this region, used to determine manufacturing and quality standards compliance requirements

properties.label: name
properties.description: Human-readable name of the regulatory region (e.g., North America, European Union, Asia-Pacific)

properties.label: region_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for a pharmaceutical regulatory region

properties.label: regulatory_body
properties.description: Primary regulatory authority governing pharmaceutical operations in this region (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)

classes.label: suppliers
classes.description: Master registry of pharmaceutical suppliers including their geographic location, business tier classification, qualification status for regulatory compliance, and associated risk ratings. Used for supplier relationship management, procurement decisions, and supply chain risk assessment.

properties.label: country
properties.description: Geographic country of origin or primary location where the supplier operates

properties.label: name
properties.description: Legal or business name of the pharmaceutical supplier

properties.label: qualified_status
properties.description: Regulatory and compliance qualification status indicating whether the supplier meets pharmaceutical industry standards and requirements for procurement eligibility

properties.label: risk_rating
properties.description: Assessment rating of supply chain and operational risk associated with the supplier for mitigation planning and monitoring purposes

properties.label: supplier_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for each pharmaceutical supplier in the system

properties.label: tier
properties.description: Business classification tier assigned to the supplier indicating their strategic importance or capability level in the supply chain

classes.label: trial_sites
classes.description: Registry of clinical trial site locations and enrollment details, tracking individual research centers participating in pharmaceutical trials with their enrollment status, dosing schedules, and supply inventory management information.

properties.label: enrolled
properties.description: Number of participants currently enrolled or enrollment status at the trial site

properties.label: next_dose_date
properties.description: Scheduled date for the next dose administration or dosing event at the site

properties.label: site_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the clinical trial research site or facility

properties.label: site_name
properties.description: Human-readable name of the clinical trial research site or facility

properties.label: supply_buffer_days
properties.description: Number of days of medication supply buffer or safety stock maintained at the trial site for inventory management

classes.label: trials
classes.description: Registry of pharmaceutical clinical trials conducted by Calanthir Pharma, tracking trial identification, drug candidates, regulatory phases, enrollment targets, and primary efficacy outcomes.

properties.label: name
properties.description: Human-readable name or title of the clinical trial, often reflecting the study protocol or therapeutic area being investigated.

properties.label: phase
properties.description: Regulatory phase of the clinical trial (Phase I, II, III, IV) indicating the stage of drug development and investigation type, from safety assessment through post-market surveillance.

properties.label: primary_endpoint
properties.description: Primary efficacy or safety outcome measure that the trial is designed to evaluate, defining the main success criterion for the study.

properties.label: status
properties.description: Current operational status of the clinical trial (e.g., active, recruiting, completed, suspended, terminated) reflecting its real-time state in the development lifecycle.

properties.label: target_enrollment
properties.description: Planned or targeted number of study participants to be enrolled in the clinical trial, representing the sample size required to achieve statistical power.

properties.label: trial_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for each clinical trial, serving as the primary reference key for trial tracking and linkage across systems.
